subject: Vendor onboarding — insurance addendum, COI and PO routing for Horizon AI
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@horizonai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding — insurance addendum, COI and PO routing for Horizon AI

Hi Tara,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. To get Horizon AI fully set up in our procurement system and queue a PO, I need a handful of items from your onboarding packet. I put a short preflight checklist below — if you can send everything back, we can kick the PO and billing workflow the same day (assuming limits match).

Required items:
- Certificate of Insurance (COI) listing Redwood Inference as "Certificate Holder" and the additional insured endorsement (see language request below).
- Endorsement that adds Redwood Inference as Additional Insured and includes Waiver of Subrogation where possible.
- W-9 (or W-8 if applicable) with the legal entity and Tax ID that should appear on the PO/invoice.
- Billing contact name, email, and remittance address for PO and invoice routing.
- Anticipated monthly spend range (helps us pick the right PO type).

Preferred insurance language (please include exactly or confirm equivalent):
"Redwood Inference, its officers, directors, employees and agents are included as Additional Insured with coverage primary and non-contributory, and a Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood Inference."

Attachments: vendor-onboarding-checklist.pdf (fillable checklist, includes PO terms and sample invoice).

Two operational notes:
1) We issue a conditional PO pending receipt of COI + W-9. Final PO will be released after we confirm endorsements and tax details.
2) For billing: we can route to your AP email (acct-pay@horizonai.com) or a single contact depending on your process.

Copying Karthik (Legal) and Marissa (Procurement Ops) to help with endorsement language and the PO queue. If you want, I can accept an initial COI without the endorsement and mark the PO as "conditional" while your broker updates the endorsement — that sometimes speeds activation.

Questions? Reply with the attachments or a time for a quick call.

Thanks,

Soojin Lee
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | (415) 555-0172

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the clear checklist — appreciate the detail. Attaching our initial COI and W-9 for your intake team: horizonai_coi_draft.pdf (COI from broker) and horizonai_w9.pdf. Our broker can issue the endorsement but wanted to confirm a couple of things first: 

1) Do you require Redwood's corporate address on the COI or is name-only (Additional Insured/Certificate Holder) sufficient?
2) If we provide the endorsement, can the PO be released the same day, or is there an additional verification step by your insurance team?

We estimate monthly spend in the $20k–$40k range to start.

If you need the broker contact, let me know and I’ll loop them in.

Best,

Tara Singh
Director, Finance & Ops
Horizon AI
tara.singh@horizonai.com | (650) 555-2246

Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — insurance addendum, COI and PO routing for Horizon AI

Hi Tara — thanks for the quick turnaround and attachments.

On your questions:
- Name-only (Additional Insured + Certificate Holder lines) is usually fine, but for our records we prefer the Certificate Holder address to read:
  Redwood Inference
  400 3rd Street, Suite 200
  San Francisco, CA 94107

- We can issue a conditional PO the same day we receive the COI and W-9, and the PO will be set to "pending endorsement." Our insurance team will do a final check on the endorsement language, which usually completes within 1 business day. If there's a minor revision needed, we keep the PO in conditional status and release final payment terms after the endorsement is received.

To speed things up, please ask your broker to attach the Additional Insured endorsement as a single page (endorsement_sample.pdf). Below is the minimal endorsement clause our legal prefers (you can paste it to your broker):

"It is agreed that the policy(ies) described herein are endorsed to include as Additional Insured: Redwood Inference, its officers, directors, employees and agents; coverage shall be primary and non-contributory and include a Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood Inference."

I've attached an example endorsement for your broker: endorsement_sample.pdf. Also, confirm the legal entity exactly as it appears on the W-9 so we match the vendor record.

When you send the updated COI with the endorsement and the final W-9, reply directly to this thread and we'll move the PO into "Active" queue.

Thanks,

Soojin Lee
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
